note: Every event, date, commit and source here is real. Only keepup's actions are simulated: what it would have done on that day had it been installed on 1 Sep. All replay dates are UTC (decisions D23 and D34): base_commit is the last upstream commit before the event's date in UTC, and the pull request is opened against it on the fork. AnythingLLM's bases are on master. AURA's three early bases were on its nightly branch on those dates and reached main later, so they aren't what main looked like that day. The Claude-only variant of PR 01 is built on ead123f0, not on afd2da90, the last commit before 22 Oct. On a pr_updated row base_commit is only the last upstream commit before that update, because the pull request stays on the base in its pr.json. days_after counts UTC days from the row's date to the commit's UTC date. Something older than the install is dated 1 Sep, the day keepup would have raised it, with its real dates in the text. A where is read at pinned_commit, unless where_at says base. A finding row counts only if the engine's checks plus a judge reach it at that commit. A pull request row is different: its spec was written by hand against the real code, and the engine isn't claimed to find it. So a team point needs something keepup really did: a finding the engine reaches, or a pull request that's built. The 35 and 28 day points are on pull request rows. A live run at f92433b4 as of 22 Sep didn't raise GPT-6 Sol or Luna (data/runs/replay-checks/anything-llm-f92433b4-2026-09-22.json), and without that point the median is 42. The gpt-4.1-nano row gets there through db/patterns and a judge, not the changelog exact check, because OpenAI's 22 Apr notice is only on its deprecations page, which data/db doesn't hold. A live run at bbefbc7f as of 1 Sep raised it, citing server/models/systemSettings.js:878 (data/runs/replay-checks/anything-llm-bbefbc7f-2026-09-01.json). That run read the 31 Oct database and a pattern list dated 1 Nov, because --as-of doesn't cut newer records. The notice itself is older than the install. AURA's prompt caching row is a finding too: a live run at 40b75ed4 as of 7 Oct raised it (data/runs/replay-checks/aura-40b75ed4-2026-10-07.json), on the same database and lever list. 40b75ed4 was on the nightly branch that day and reached main on 9 Oct, like two of AURA's early bases.
